This is a finite-lookahead/receding-horizon policy outcome, not evidence that added bandwidth reduces the attainable optimum. No failed/censored transfer is used to explain the drop.

network_model.host_proof: For each proportional phase, each individual source history receives at most 80/64 Gbps; counts greater than one denote distinct histories. Existing unique-history mass constraints reserve each history once across both routes. Thus any placement of at most 64 histories per host respects 80 Gbps. Each permanently reserved destination GPU gets at most 80/8 Gbps. Idle shares, including six unused modeled GPU slots on the final partial host, are not borrowed. Fractional wave masses are divisible reservation populations, not observed physical host assignments.

Incomplete per-wave byte progress and instantaneous rate traces are not persisted; instantaneous host-limit validity also relies on the reviewed allocator and fixed-share proof, not a reconstructed hardware trace.

import ast,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('outputs/a100-bandwidth-ttft-20260911/validation/network-review.json')
a=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256((p.parent.parent/'config.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['config_sha256']
def numerical_tree(source):
    tree=ast.parse(source)
    tree.body=[n for n in tree.body if not isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) or n.name!='plot']
    return ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=False)
for path,expected in a['source_inputs_sha256'].items():
    current=Path(path).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()!=expected:
        assert path=='pool_shed_bandwidth_sweep.py',path
        pinned=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',a['source_revision']+':agent-migrate/queue-haul/'+path])
        assert hashlib.sha256(pinned).hexdigest()==expected,path
        assert numerical_tree(current)==numerical_tree(pinned),path
for row in a['results']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((p.parent.parent/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path']
print('All frozen input and reviewed record hashes verified; only plotting changes may differ.')
